chapter.verse: Tua ciangin siampi lianpenpa in, “Hih thute ahi mah hiam?” ci-in dong hi.
Stephen in hih bangin dawng hi: “Sanggamte leh pate aw, na ngai un. I pa Abraham, Haran ah a ten ma, Mesopotamia ah a om lai-in ama' tungah minpha Pasian na kilang a,
‘Na gam na lei leh na beh na phungte' kiangpan paikhia inla kong lah ding gam ah hong pai in,’ ci hi.
Amah zong Chaldea mite' gam pan paikhia-in Haran ah teeng hi. A pa a sih ciangin Pasian in tua mun panin tu-a na tenna uh ahi hih gam ah kituahsak hi.

Ahi zongin Pasian in Abraham pen tua gam ah gamh a kici, khepek cia khat nangawn zong pia lo himah taleh ama' tung ahi zongin, ta nei nailo hinapi ama' nunga a suanlekhakte' tung ahi zongin tua gam piak dingin na kamciam hi.
Pasian in a genna ah ama' suanlekhakte midangte' gam khat ah pemta hiding uh a, tua mite in amaute salin nei-in kum zali sung khelbawl ding uh, ci hi.
Pasian in, ‘Ahih hangin sal-a a nei tua gam tungah thukhenna ka pia ding a, tua khit ciangin amaute hong paikhia-in hih mun ah kei hong bia ding uh hi,’ ci hi.
Tua ciangin Abraham tungah vun-at thuciamna pia hi. Tua mah bangin Abraham in tapa Isaac nei a, ni giatni ciangin vun at hi. Isaac in zong tapa Jacob nei a, Jacob pen i pupi sawmlenihte' pa ahi hi.
“Pupite in Joseph a hazat manun Egypt mite' kiangah a zuak uh hangin Pasian in amah ompih a,
a gentheihna khempeuh pan honkhia-in Egypt kumpi Pharaoh' mai-ah kilawmna leh pilna guan ahih manin Pharaoh in Egypt gam sung leh ama' kumpi inn sung ukpi dingin seh hi.
Tu-in Egypt leh Canaan mun citeng ah kialpi leh gimna lianpi tung a, i pupite in annek mu zolo uh hi.
Ahih hangin Egypt ah an om cih Jacob in a zak ciangin i pupite a khatveina sawl hi.
A nihveina ciangin a sanggamte' theih dingin Joseph kipulak a, Pharaoh in zong Joseph' innkuan thu theihpih ta hi.
Tua ciangin Joseph in mi sawlin a pa Jacob leh a innkuanpihte, a vekun mihing sawmsagih-le-nga, sam hi.
Jacob zong Egypt ah pai a, amah ahi-a i pupite ahi zongin si uh hi.
Amaute Shechem ah kipuakik a, tua khua-a Hamor' tate' tungpan Abraham in ngun sumtang tawh a na lei khitsa hankhuk sungah kivui hi.
“Ahih hangin Abraham' kianga Pasian' khapsa kamciam tangtun hun a nai ciangin Egypt ah amaute pungin khang a,
Joseph a thei lo kumpi dang khat Egypt uk dingin hong khan hun dong tampi pha uh hi.
Tua kumpipa in ei minamte hong khembawl a, i pupite khelbawlin naungek a suakthakte a hinsuak theihloh nadingun koihkhiasak hi.
Tua hun lianin Pasian' mai-ah a pahtak-huai Moses suak a, kha thum sung a pa' inn ah kikem kikhoi hi.
A kikoihkhiat ciangin Pharaoh' tanu in tawm a, ama' sungsuak ta bangin kemin khoi hi.
Tua hi a, Moses pen Egypt mite' pilna a namkim tawh a kipantah hi a, thugen leh nasep siam mahmah hi.
“Khankum sawmli a phak ciangin a sanggam Israel mite va van ding cih a lungsim ah suak hi.
Mipihte khat a kimawk vuak a muh ciangin tua a thuakpa hu a, a thuhsakna-in Egypt mipa that hi.
Ama' khut tungtawnin a mipihte Pasian in hotkhiatna pia ding cih thu a mipihte in a na tel dingin Moses in ummawh a, ahi zongin amaute in na tel tuanlo uh hi.
A zingciangin amaute a kitot laitak Moses pai-in a kilem nadingun va phelh a, ‘Lawmte aw, sanggam khat na hi uh hi. Bang hangin khatlekhat kimawk vuak na hi uh hiam?’ ci hi.
Ahih hangin a vengpa a mawk vuak mipa in Moses sawnkhia a, ‘Ko' tungah ukpi dingin leh thukhen mang dingin nang kua in hong seh hiam?
Zanni-a Egypt mipa na thah danin kei zong hong that nuam na hi hiam?’ ci hi.
Hih thu a zak ciangin Moses taimang a, Midian gam ah pemta suakin tua takah tapa nih nei hi.
“Tua khit kum sawmli a khen ciangin ama' kiangah vanmi khat, Sinai Mual gamgawtak lak, sawlbawk meikuang sungah kilang hi.
Moses in a muh ciangin tua muhtuamna lamdang sa hi. A encian dingin a nehphei leh Topa' awging hong om a,
‘Kei pen na pupite' Pasian, Abraham' Pasian, Isaac' Pasian, Jacob' Pasian, ka hi hi,’ ci hi. Moses zong a ciliingin encian ngamlo hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in, ‘Na khe-a khedap suahkhia in; na dinna mun leitual siangtho hi.
Egypt gama om ka mite' thuak khelbawlna teltak mu-in amaute' thumna tauna ka za khinzo a, amaute a honkhia dingin kong paisuk ta hi. Tu-in hong pai in, Egypt ah kong sawl ding hi,’ ci hi.

“‘Ko' tungah ukpi leh thukhen mang a sem dingin nang kua in hong seh hiam?’ ci-a a nolh uh hih mipa Moses pen sawlbawk panin ama' kianga kilang vanmi' khut tungtawnin Pasian in ukpi leh honpa ahikhawm dingin hong sawl hi.
Hih mipa in amaute paikhiatpih a, kum sawmli sung Egypt gam, San Tuipi leh gamgawtak lakah nalamdang leh kihilna limte bawl hi.
Hih Moses pen Israel mite' kiangah, ‘Pasian in na mipihte uh sungpan kei bang kamsang khat hong khangsak ding hi,’ a ci mipa ahi hi.

Amah pen Sinai Mual tunga amah a hopih vanmi tawh ahi zongin, i pupite tawh ahi zongin gamgawtak sung, sapkhiat mipawlte lakah a ompa ahi hi. Amah in ei' tungah hong piak dingin a nungta kammalte ngah hi.
I pupite in ama' thu mang nuam lo-in amah sawnkhia uh hi. A lungsim uh Egypt gam ah kilehkik ahih manin
Aaron' kiangah, ‘Hih, Egypt gam pana eite hong paikhiatpih Moses bangci ta cih thei lo i hih manin eite' mai-ah a pai ding pasiante hong bawlsak in,’ ci uh hi.
Tua hun sungin amaute in bawngno milim khat bawlin tua milim thoih uh a, amau' bawltawm nate tawh lungkim nuamsa uh hi.

Ahih hangin amaute' kiangpan Pasian kihei-in vantung vangliatnate a bia dingun nusia hi. Tua pen kamsang laibu sunga kigelh bang ahi hi: “‘Israel innkuante aw, kum sawmli sung gamgawtak lakah gan kigote leh biakpiak vante kei' kiangah hong paipih na hi uh hiam?
Note' ken pen Moloch ii puanbuk leh na pasian uh Rephan ii aksi hi a, biak dingin na bawl uh milimte ahi hi. Tua hangin Babylon khengin note kong nawnkhia ding hi.’
“Moses a hopihpa in Moses' kiangah a muhkhak etsakna lim zui-in puanbuk lam dingin a vaikhak mah bangin i pupite in gamgawtak ah teci panna puanbuk na nei uh hi.
I pupite in amaute' mai pan Pasian' hawlkhiat Gentile-te' gam a luah uh ciangin Joshua tawh tua puanbuk na lutpih uh a, David' khang dong kem uh hi.
David in Pasian' maipha mu a, Jacob suante' Pasian ii tenna mun ding khat a ngah nading ngen hi.
Ahih hangin ama' ading biakinn a lam pen Solomon ahi hi
Himah taleh mihing' khut tawh kibawl innte ah Sangpenpa teeng lo hi. Kamsangpa in zong hih bangin na gen hi:
“‘Topa in ci hi: Vantung, ka kumpi-tokhom hi a, leitung, ka khe-ngakna tokhom hi. Kei' ading biakinn bangci nam hong lamsak ding a, ka tawlngakna mun koitak hiding hiam?
Hihte khempeuh ka khut tawh ka bawl hilo ahi hiam?’
“No, lungtang a khauh, lungsim leh bil vun-atloh mite aw, Kha Siangtho na lehpan den uh hi. Na pupite mah na bang uh hi.
Na pupite uh' bawlsiat loh kamsang kua om ahi hiam? Amaute in Midikpa' hong pai ding thu a pulakkhol mite that uh a, tu-in zong note in tua Midikpa lehhekin na tualthah uh hi.
Note in vanmite' hong puakna tawh thukhun ngah khin napi-in na zui tuankei uh hi.”
Hih thute a zak uh ciangin amaute nakpi lungso uh a, Stephen enin hagawi uh hi.
Ahih hangin Stephen pen Kha Siangtho tawh kidim a, vantung lam a ettoh ciangin Pasian' minpha vangtaang leh Pasian' taklama a ding Jesu mu hi.
Tua ciangin, “En un, vantung kihong ka mu a, Pasian' taklam ah Mihing' Tapa ding hi,” ci hi.
Ahih hangin amaute a bil uh humin awging lianpi tawh kiko uh a, lung kituakin Stephen bawhhuan uh hi.
Tua ciangin khuasung pan kaikhia uh a, suang tawh deng uh hi. A mu a thei teci teng in zong a puantungsilhte uh suahin Saul minnei khangno tangval khat ii khe-phung ah koih uh hi.
Tua bangin suang tawh a den laitakun Stephen in, “Topa Jesu aw, ka kha hong la ta in,” ci-in thungen hi.
Tua ciangin khukdin a, “Topa aw, hih mawhna amaute' tungah na nga kei in,” ci-in awging lianpi tawh kiko hi. Tua khit ciangin amah ihmu hi.
